polityNote: Argentine Republic, 1884-10-16 (Ley 1532 of the national territories) to 2019. Atoms are the IGN departamentos/partidos and the 15 comunas of Buenos Aires (geoBoundaries ARG ADM2, 2020, CC BY 3.0 IGO); a province or territory is drawn only from the day its whole outline is the atoms' line, and is unresolved before. The Falklands, South Georgia and the Antarctic sector are not atoms. (1) independent check (2026-10-06): the three departments that were the Los Andes territory total 63,642 km² against the territory's ~62,642 km² (1.6% more; Susques 7% more) — one reason Los Andes is left unresolved. Unions against IGN published areas: La Pampa 1.000, Chaco 1.003, Jujuy 1.003, Misiones 1.006, Corrientes 1.012, Capital 1.015, Buenos Aires 0.994, Tierra del Fuego 0.955 (Isla Grande Argentine part), Formosa 1.050 (75,648 vs 72,066 km²; the atoms reach further into the Pilcomayo/Paraguay river margins). Rewritten 2026-10-06 from the earlier ne-admin1 dossier (scope from 1955), whose post-1955 facts are kept; two of its starts were corrected (Mendoza, Salta: later limit acts it had missed).
